snippet.description:
చిత్తూ చుత్తుల బొమ్మ 🌸 ఎమ్మేమి పువ్వొత్తునే | ఒక్కేసి పువ్వేసి | Bathukamma Patalu | Telangana Folk Songs | చిత్తూ చుత్తుల బొమ్మ ఎమ్మేమి పువ్వొత్తునే | ఒక్కేసి పువ్వేసి | Bathukamma Patalu | Batukamma Songs
చిత్తూ చుత్తుల బొమ్మ, ఎమ్మేమి పువ్వొత్తునే, ఒక్కేసి పువ్వేసి, Bathukamma Patalu, Bathukamma Songs Telugu, Bathukamma Folk Songs, Telangana Bathukamma Songs, Telugu Folk Songs, Latest Bathukamma Songs, Bathukamma Special Songs, Traditional Bathukamma Patalu, Telangana Folk Music, DJ Bathukamma Songs, Bathukamma Festival 
🌸 Celebrate Telangana's beautiful Bathukamma festival with these popular traditional Bathukamma Patalu! Enjoy the festive folk melodies of **చిత్తూ చుత్తుల బొమ్మ, ఎమ్మేమి పువ్వొత్తునే, ఒక్కేసి పువ్వేసి** and make your Bathukamma celebrations more joyful with traditional Telugu folk music.

🌺 తెలంగాణ సంస్కృతి, సంప్రదాయాలకు ప్రతీక అయిన బతుకమ్మ పండుగ సందర్భంగా మీ కోసం ప్రత్యేకమైన బతుకమ్మ పాటలు. చిత్తూ చుత్తుల బొమ్మ, ఎమ్మేమి పువ్వొత్తునే, ఒక్కేసి పువ్వేసి వంటి అందమైన జానపద గీతాలను ఆస్వాదించండి. మీ బతుకమ్మ సంబరాల్లో ఈ పాటలతో ఆనందాన్ని పంచుకోండి!

💐 బతుకమ్మ పండుగ శుభాకాంక్షలు! 💐

❤️ పాటలు నచ్చితే Like చేయండి  
🌸 మీ స్నేహితులు, కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో Share చేయండి  
🔔 మరిన్ని తెలుగు జానపద పాటలు, బతుకమ్మ పాటల కోసం **S FOCUS FOLK SONGS** ఛానెల్‌ను Subscribe చేయండి.

Academy Award®️ nominee Scarlett Johansson fronts The Exorcist: Martyrs, an unsettling new chapter in one of the most storied titles in cinema history from genre auteur Mike Flanagan, the creator of  acclaimed series The Haunting of Hill House, The Fall of the House of Usher, Midnight Mass, and the  upcoming Carrie, as well as the films Doctor Sleep, The Life of Chuck, Hush and Gerald’s Game. 

Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller (Johansson) ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy’s blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.  

Aided by former prison chaplain Father William (Academy Award®️ nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor), who heard Father Sunday’s final confession, and sharp rookie detective Gina Restrepo (Sasha Calle, The Rip), Detective Miller will discover a filament linking a lineage of serial killers, from H.H. Holmes to the Zodiac, that could corrupt everything, and everyone, she loves with an evil that goes well beyond the mortal.  

The top-flight cast includes Academy Award®️ nominee Diane Lane as Mary, Detective Miller’s mother, who has moved in with her to help raise her grandson Max (Jacobi Jupe, Hamnet); Actor Award winner Scoot McNairy (Argo) as paroled convict Clay Silver; Emmy winner Gil Bellows (Carrie) as Peter Nicks, a former acolyte of Father Sunday; Emmy and Tony winning screen legend Laurence Fishburne as revered priest Father Nichol; and acclaimed star of The Odyssey, Emmy and Special Tony Award winner John Leguizamo, in the most menacing role of his career as Father Sunday.

The Exorcist: Martyrs is written and directed by Mike Flanagan, based on characters created by William Peter Blatty. The film is produced by David Robinson (The Exorcist series, Dead Ringers series), three time Academy Award®️ nominee Jason Blum (Get Out, Black Phone films) and Mike Flanagan. The film is executive produced by Alexandra Magistro and Ryan Turek.

snippet.title: JAILER 2 Teaser & Trailer Reaction! | Rajinikanth | S. J. Suryah | Mithun Chakraborty | Vidya Balan
snippet.description:
Jaby and Brandon react to the teaser and trailer of **JAILER 2**, the highly anticipated sequel starring Superstar Rajinikanth! The Tiger is back, and the first glimpses of this next chapter promise an exciting mix of intense action, larger-than-life moments, and intriguing new characters. With plenty of details to unpack and so many questions about what's coming next for Muthuvel Pandian, Jaby and Brandon dive into the footage to share their thoughts, reactions, and excitement for what's shaping up to be another major cinematic event!

*Jailer 2* brings together an impressive ensemble cast led by Rajinikanth (*Jailer, Enthiran, Sivaji*), alongside S. J. Suryah (*Mersal, Maanaadu, Mark Antony*), Mithun Chakraborty (*Disco Dancer, Agneepath, Guru*), Suraj Venjaramoodu (*Driving Licence, Android Kunjappan Version 5.25, The Great Indian Kitchen*), Ramya Krishnan (*Baahubali: The Beginning, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion, Padayappa*), and Vidya Balan (*Kahaani, The Dirty Picture, Bhool Bhulaiyaa*). With such a talented lineup of established stars from across Indian cinema, the sequel promises an exciting combination of screen presence, memorable performances, and larger-than-life entertainment.

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar (*Jailer, Doctor, Beast*), *Jailer 2* sees Rajinikanth return as the iconic Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. With Anirudh Ravichander returning to deliver the music, anticipation is high to see how the sequel builds on the action, dark humor, and unforgettable moments that made the original *Jailer* such a hit. Will the next chapter take things to an entirely new level? Join Jaby and Brandon as they break down the teaser and trailer and share their reactions to one of the most anticipated films in Indian cinema!

If you are looking for a comedy short film and family entertainer set against the backdrop of this ritualistic period, you are likely referring to the widely-trending sketches and 3D animated comedy shorts that surface during this season.
Because Pitru Paksha is traditionally a solemn period for honoring ancestors, comedy creators use the unique, everyday cultural quirks of Indian families during these 16 days to create hilarious, lighthearted family entertainment.
Here is a general description of what these highly popular Pitru Paksha comedy family short films entail:

🎬 Typical Plot & Setting

The story usually revolves around a traditional middle-class Indian household trying to strictly follow the rules of Shradh (ancestral rituals). The comedy stems from the generational gap between tech-savvy, modern kids and superstitious or strict elders who are anxious about making a mistake.

Tumhara nasha bada gajab ka hai.
Tumhari ada sabse alag aur anokhi lagti hai.
Tumhara figure bilkul kisi heroine jaisa hai.

Jab bhi hum tumhe dekhte hain, bechain ho jaate hain.

LV, Gucci aur Prada jaise bade brands pehan kar sabko style dikhati ho.

snippet.description:
शारदीय नवरात्रि के प्रथम दिन माँ शैलपुत्री की पावन आरती के दर्शन और श्रवण का सौभाग्य प्राप्त करें।  माँ शैलपुत्री, माँ दुर्गा का प्रथम स्वरूप हैं और नवरात्रि के पहले दिन भक्तजन उनकी पूजा-अर्चना कर सुख, शांति, समृद्धि और शक्ति की कामना करते हैं। इस दिव्य आरती के माध्यम से माँ जगदंबा की भक्ति में लीन हों और अपने जीवन को उनकी कृपा एवं आशीर्वाद से मंगलमय बनाएँ। माँ शैलपुत्री सभी भक्तों की मनोकामनाएँ पूर्ण करें। 

Subscribe us: @spirtualactivity 

Make reel on Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/reels/audio/460517449644398/

माँ शैलपुत्री आरती Lyrics:

जय शैलपुत्री माता जय शैलपुत्री माता
रूप अलौकिक पावन रूप अलौकिक पावन
शुभ फल की दाता जय शैलपुत्री माता

हाथ त्रिशूल कमल दल मैया के साजे 
मेरी मैया के साजे शीश मुकुट शोभा मयी 
शीश मुकुट शोभा मयी मैया के साजे जय शैलपुत्री माता

दक्ष राज की कन्या शिव अर्धांगिनी तुम
मैया शिव अर्धांगिनी तुम तुम ही हो सती माता
तुम ही हो सती माता पाप विनाशिनी तुम जय शैलपुत्री माता

ऋषभ सवारी माँ की सुंदर अति पावन
है सुंदर अति पावन सौभाग्यशाली बनता
सौभाग्यशाली बनता जो कर नित दर्शन जय शैलपुत्री माता

आदी अनादि अनामय माँ तुम अविनाशी
माँ तुम हो अविनाशी अटल अनंत अगोचर
अटल अनंत अगोचर अजय आनंद राशि जय शैलपुत्री माता

नवदुर्गो में मैया प्रथम तेरा ये स्थान
माँ प्रथम तेरा ये स्थान रिद्धि सिद्धि पा जाता
रिद्धि सिद्धि पा जाता जो धरता तेरा ध्यान जय शैलपुत्री माता

प्रथम नवरात्रे जो माँ व्रत तेरा धारे
माँ व्रत तेरा धारे करदे कृपा उस जन पे
करदे कृपा उस जन पे तू मैया तारे जय शैलपुत्री माता

मूलाधार निवासिनी हमपे कृपा करना
माँ हम पे कृपा करना लाल तुम्हारे ही हम
लाल तुम्हारे ही हम दृष्टी दया रखना जय शैलपुत्री माता

करुणामयी जग जननी दया नज़र कीजे
माँ दया नज़र कीजे शिव सती शैलपुत्री माँ 
शिव सती शैलपुत्री माँ चरण शरण लीजिये जय शैलपुत्री माता

snippet.title: Steady. Sharp. Closing In. 😤 | Semi-Finals Day 2 | TAG Vlog
snippet.description:
Day 1 was about grabbing the top spot. Day 2 was about proving it wasn’t a one-off.

And the boys did exactly that. 😤

No wild swings, no panic, no throwaway games. Just TAG doing what TAG does when it’s locked in: smart rotations, disciplined fights, and points coming in match after match. It wasn’t always flashy, but it was the kind of day that wins tournaments. The Grand Finals are now right in front of us.

The vlog has the full day: the calm in the green room, the calls that kept the squad out of trouble, the fights we picked on our own terms, and the post-match chat where nobody was getting carried away. Everyone knows the job isn’t finished yet.

Think about how this run has gone. A rough Upper Bracket Day 2. A last-match WWCD miracle to make the semis. Top of the table on Semi-Finals Day 1. And now another steady day that keeps us right in the hunt. Every vlog in this series has been a step, and the next one could be the biggest. 🏆

One more push and we’re there.

snippet.title: नवरात्रि का पहला दिन : ॐ जय शैलपुत्री माता ~ माँ शैलपुत्री की आरती Shailputri Aarti Navratri Day-1
snippet.description:
Bhakti Bhajan Sagar Presents ...
नवरात्रि का पहला दिन : ॐ जय शैलपुत्री माता ~ माँ शैलपुत्री की आरती Shailputri Aarti Navratri Day-1.

Song : Shailputri Mata ki Aarti
Singer :  Ruchi Khandelwal
Music : Shankar Maheshwari
Lyrics : Traditional
Channel : Bhakti Bhajan Sagar

Lyrics in Hindi:
जय शैलपुत्री माता
मैया जय शैलपुत्री माता।
रूप अलौकिक पावन
शुभ फल की दाता॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

हाथ त्रिशूल कमल तल
मैया के साजे ।
शीश मुकुट शोभामयी
मैया के साजे ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

दक्षराज की कन्या
शिव अर्धांगिनी तुम ।
तुम ही हो सती माता
पाप विनाशिनी तुम ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

वृषभ सवारी माँ की
सुन्दर अति पावन ।
सौभाग्यशाली बनता
जो करले दर्शन ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

आदि अनादि अनामय
तुम माँ अविनाशी ।
अटल अनत अगोचर
अतुल आनंद राशि ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

नौ दुर्गाओं में मैया
प्रथम तेरा स्थान ।
रिद्धि सिद्धि पा जाता
जो धरता तेरा ध्यान ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

प्रथम नवरात्रे जो माँ
व्रत तेरा धरे ।
करदे कृपा उस जन पे
तू मैया तारे ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

मूलाधार निवासिनी
हमपे कृपा करना ।
लाल तुम्हारे ही हम
द्रष्टि दया रखना ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

करुणामयी जगजननी
दया नज़र कीजे ।
शिवसती शैलपुत्री माँ
चरण शरण लिजे ॥

जय शैलपुत्री माता ॥

यह भक्तिमय गीत माँ के प्रति प्रेम, आस्था और समर्पण को दर्शाता है। माता रानी के भक्त इस सुंदर Bhojpuri Devi Geet / Mata Rani Bhajan को सुनें और भक्ति के रंग में डूब जाएँ। 🌺🙏

snippet.title: Arvind Kejriwal Released LIVE: केजरीवाल को दिल्ली पुलिस ने रिहा किया | CJP Protest | Jantar Mantar
snippet.description:
आम आदमी पार्टी (AAP) के संयोजक अरविंद केजरीवाल समेत पार्टी के नेताओं को दिल्ली पुलिस ने हिरासत से रिहा कर दिया है. केजरीवाल को लोधी एस्टेट से हिरासत में लिया गया था और जाफरपुर कलां पुलिस स्टेशन में रखा गया था. अरविंद केजरीवाल, संजय सिंह और दुर्गेश पाठक को CJP के विरोध प्रदर्शन के आह्वान के समर्थन में मार्च निकालने की कोशिश के दौरान हिरासत में लिया गया था. रिहाई के बाद केजरीवाल ने सोशल मीडिया पर एक वीडियो जारी कर कहा, 'मोदी जी, आपकी जेलें कम पड़ जाएंगी. देश के युवाओं से उलझने की हिम्मत मत करना. ज्ञानेश कुमार का इस्तीफा लो और वोट चोरी बंद करो.'

Title : Om Jai Ambe Gauri
Singer : Anuradha Paudwal
Lyrics : Traditional
Music : D Sushant ,Deep Goswami 
Music Arranger : Sanjay Marathe 
Rhythm Programming : Pt Navin Sharma 
Music Label: Wings Music 
© & ℗ Wings Entertainment Ltd.

Lyrics:
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri
मैया जय श्यामा गौरी
Maiya Jai Shyama Gauri
तुमको निसदिन ध्यावत
Tumko Nis Din Dhyavat
तुमको निसदिन ध्यावत
Tumko Nis Din Dhyavat
हरि ब्रह्मा शिवरी
Hari Brahma Shivri
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

मांग सिंदूर विराजत
Maang Sindoor Virajat
टीको मृगमद को
Teeko Mrigmad Ko
मैया टीको मृगमद को
Maiya Teeko Mrigmad Ko
उज्ज्वल से दोउ नैना
Ujjwal Se Dou Naina
चंद्रवदन नीको
Chandravadana Neeko
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

कनक समान कलेवर
Kanak Samaan Kalevar
रक्ताम्बर राजै
Raktambar Raajai
मैया रक्ताम्बर राजै
Maiya Raktambar Raajai
रक्तपुष्प गल माला
Raktpushp Gal Mala
कंठन पर साजै
Kanthan Par Saajai
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

केहरि वाहन राजत
Kehari Vahan Rajat
खड्ग खप्पर धारी
Khadag Khappar Dhaari
मैया खड्ग खप्पर धारी
Maiya Khadag Khappar Dhaari
सुर नर मुनिजन सेवत
Sur Nar Munijan Sevat
तिनके दुखहारी
Tinke Dukhhaari
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

कानन कुण्डल शोभित
Kaanan Kundal Shobhit
नासाग्रे मोती
Nasagre Moti
मैया नासाग्रे मोती
Maiya Nasagre Moti
कोटिक चंद्र दिवाकर
Kotik Chandra Divakar
सम राजत ज्योति
Sam Rajat Jyoti
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

शूम्भ निशूम्भ बिधारे
Shumbh Nishumbh Bidhaare
महिषासुर घाती
Mahishasur Ghaati
मैया महिषासुर घाती
Maiya Mahishasur Ghaati
धूम्र विलोचन नैना
Dhoomra Vilochan Naina
निशा दिन मधमाती
Nisha Din Madhmaati
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

चण्ड-मुण्ड संहारे
Chand-Mund Sanhaare
शोणित बीज हरे
Shonit Beej Hare
मैया शोणित बीज हरे
Maiya Shonit Beej Hare
मधु-कैटभ दोउ मारे
Madhu-Kaitabh Dou Maare
सुर भयहीन करे
Sur Bhayheen Kare
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

ब्रह्माणी रूद्राणी
Brahmani Rudrani
तुम कमला रानी
Tum Kamla Rani
मैया तुम कमला रानी
Maiya Tum Kamla Rani
आगम निगम बखानी
Aagam Nigam Bakhaani
तुम शिव पटरानी
Tum Shiv Patrani
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

चौंसठ योगिनी मंगल गावत
Chaunsath Yogini Mangal Gaavat
नृत्य करत भैरों
Nritya Karat Bhairon
मैया नृत्य करत भैरों
Maiya Nritya Karat Bhairon
बाजत ताल मृदंगा
Baajat Taal Mridanga
अरू बाजत डमरू
Aru Baajat Damru
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

तुम ही जग की माता
Tum Hi Jag Ki Mata
तुम ही हो भरता
Tum Hi Ho Bharta
मैया तुम ही हो भरता
Maiya Tum Hi Ho Bharta
भक्तन की दुख हरता
Bhaktan Ki Dukh Harta
सुख संपति करता
Sukh Sampati Karta
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

भुजा चार अति शोभित
Bhuja Chaar Ati Shobhit
वर मुद्रा धारी
Var Mudra Dhaari
मैया वर मुद्रा धारी
Maiya Var Mudra Dhaari
मनवांछित फल पावत
Manvaanchhit Phal Paavat
सेवत नर नारी
Sevat Nar Naari
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

कंचन थाल विराजत
Kanchan Thaal Virajat
अगर कपूर बाती
Agar Kapoor Baati
मैया अगर कपूर बाती
Maiya Agar Kapoor Baati
श्रीमालकेतु में राजत
Shrimal Ketu Mein Rajat
कोटि रतन ज्योती
Koti Ratan Jyoti
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

माँ अंबे जी की आरती
Maa Ambe Ji Ki Aarti
जो कोइ नर गावे
Jo Koi Nar Gaave
मैया जो कोइ जन गावे
Maiya Jo Koi Jan Gaave
कहत शिवानंद स्वामी
Kahat Shivanand Swami
सुख संपति पावे
Sukh Sampati Paave
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी
Om Jai Ambe Gauri

Maiya Jai Shyama Gauri

Tumko Nis Din Dhyavat

Tumko Nis Din Dhyavat
हरि ब्रह्मा शिवरी
Hari Brahma Shivri

snippet.title: Mahishasuramardini - Mahalaya | মহালয়া | Birendra Krishna Bhadra | Pankaj Mullick | Bani Kumar
snippet.description:
শিউলির গন্ধ, ভোরের আকাশে কাশফুলের দোলা আর চণ্ডীপাঠের পবিত্র আবহ—মহালয়ার ভোর মানেই বাঙালির মনে দুর্গাপুজোর আগমনী সুর। 🙏✨

মা দুর্গার মর্ত্যে আগমনকে স্বাগত জানিয়ে মহালয়ার এই শুভক্ষণে শুনুন ‘মহিষাসুরমর্দিনী’—শক্তি, ভক্তি ও আধ্যাত্মিকতার এক অনন্য পরিবেশনা। দেবী দুর্গার অসুরবধ ও শুভশক্তির জয়ের কাহিনি আজও প্রতিটি বাঙালির হৃদয়ে জাগিয়ে তোলে ভক্তি ও আবেগ।

Script : Bani Kumar Music Director : Pankaj Kumar Mallick Narration & Chanting of Slokas - Birendra Krishna Bhadra Singers - Supreeti Ghosh, Dwijen Mukherjee, Sumitra Sen, Krishna Dasgupta, Pankaj Mallick, Utpala Sen, Sandhya Mukherjee, Pratima Mukherjee, Tarun Banerjee & Others 

Mahalaya, signifies the termination of Pitri Paksha and the beginning of Devi Paksha, thus ushering in the season of religious festivals. It is said that Devi Durga begins her journey from her husband's abode in Kailash to her paternal home on this day. The glory of Durga is known from the ancient treatise Durga Saptasati or the Chandi. It describes the incarnation of Devi Durga by the unification process of all the power of the Gods and her emergence as Mahisasuramardini in the eventual fight with Mahisasura. Recitation of these slokas is known as Chandi Path and has been recited and known to combat every kind of enmity and adversity, from ages forgotten. Since the early 1930s, homes in Bengal reverberate with the immortal verses from Chandi Kabya in the recorded voice of late Birendra Krishna Bhadra. It is a beautiful audio montage of recitation in the enthralling voice of Birendra Krishna Bhadra, Bengali devotional songs with narration scripted by Bani Kumar, classical music composed by Pankaj Kumar Mullick and a dash of acoustic melodrama.

snippet.title: LAAL RANG SENURA BA | BHARAT SHARMA VYAS | NAVRATRI SPECIAL BHOJPURI DEVI BHAJAN
snippet.description:
As the sacred festival of Navratri begins tomorrow, welcome the divine blessings of Maa Durga with the soulful Bhojpuri Devi Bhajan “Laal Rang Senura Ba,” sung by the renowned Bhojpuri artist Bharat Sharma Vyas, who also composed the music.

Let this devotional melody fill your heart and home with faith, peace, positivity, and the divine energy of Maa Durga. Celebrate the nine auspicious days with devotion and share this beautiful Bhojpuri bhajan with your family and friends.

May Maa Durga bless everyone with happiness, good health, prosperity, and success.

🌺 Wishing you and your family a blessed and joyful Navratri!

🙏 Jai Mata Di! Jai Maa Durga! 🙏

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

काल्ह से शुरू होखे वाला नवरात्रि के पावन अवसर पर सुनल जाव भोजपुरी के भक्तिमय देवी भजन “लाल रंग सेनुरा बा”, जवना के आवाज आ संगीत भोजपुरी के प्रसिद्ध गायक भारत शर्मा व्यास के बा।

माई दुर्गा के भक्ति में डूबल ई भजन रउरा मन में श्रद्धा, विश्वास आ भक्ति के भाव जगाई। नवरात्रि के पावन दिन में माई के आराधना करीं आ एह भक्तिमय भजन के अपना परिवार आ संगी-साथियन के संगे शेयर करीं।

माई दुर्गा सभका जीवन में सुख, शांति, समृद्धि आ खुशहाली ले आवसु। सभके मनोकामना पूरा होखे आ माई के आशीर्वाद हमेशा बनल रहे।

🌺 रउरा आ रउरा परिवार के नवरात्रि के ढेर सारा शुभकामना!

🙏 जय माता दी! जय माई दुर्गा! 🙏

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
